markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation expanding Medicaid eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level is enacted in Texas before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, expanding Medicaid means a Texas law, including a state budget act, that extends Texas Medicaid eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, or that directs or authorizes the Health and Human Services Commission to do so. It may contain other provisions and may use any legislative vehicle. A law that requires federal approval or takes effect after the deadline counts once enacted. A law that directs or authorizes the Health and Human Services Commission to seek a federal waiver or state plan amendment covering adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, including through private health plans paid for by Medicaid, counts. A law that takes effect only if voters approve a constitutional amendment counts once voters approve that amendment. A work or activity requirement does not prevent a law from counting.

A law that only creates a public option or buy-in, raises the income limit to a level below 138% of the federal poverty level, orders a study, or requests a federal waiver that would not cover adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, and any change that only affects Medicaid funding, provider payments or benefits, do NOT count.
markets.title: Will Texas expand Medicaid before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic Party holds more seats than any other party in the Wisconsin Senate after the Wisconsin legislative election held on November 7, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election, including holdover seats not up for election.

Each member is counted once, for the party designation shown by the State of Wisconsin (for holdover members, as of the date of the general election). Events after the date of the general election, such as party switches, deaths, resignations, vacancies, appointments, special elections, and any decision by the Wisconsin Senate to refuse to seat or to expel a member-elect, are disregarded. Independent and unaffiliated members do NOT count for any party, even if they caucus with one.

Coalitions, power-sharing agreements and the election of chamber leaders do NOT count.

In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied parties).

This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project that a party has won a majority of the seats in the Wisconsin Senate.

Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election.

Each member is counted once, for the party designation shown by the State of Oklahoma. Events after the date of the general election, such as party switches, deaths, resignations, vacancies, appointments, special elections, and any decision by the Oklahoma House of Representatives to refuse to seat or to expel a member-elect, are disregarded. Independent and unaffiliated members do NOT count for any party, even if they caucus with one.

Coalitions, power-sharing agreements and the election of chamber leaders do NOT count.

In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied parties).

This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project that a party has won a majority of the seats in the Oklahoma House of Representatives.
markets.title: Will the Democratic Party hold the most seats in the Oklahoma State House after the 2028 election?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire at the first 10:00 AM ET following the occurrence of an event encompassed by the Payout Criterion for any party, based on the states' and DC's certificates of ascertainment of presidential election results.
markets.rules_primary: If a member of the Democratic Party wins the popular vote in 2028 by a margin of between 9.00-100.00%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The popular vote margin is calculated as (total votes for the winner minus total votes for second place) divided by total votes, times 100, rounded to two decimal places. The calculation uses the states' and DC's most recent certificates of ascertainment of presidential election results as of the date of the January joint session of Congress. If multiple certificates of ascertainment are sent to Congress for a state, the one Congress counts is used. If Congress rejects all certificates for a state, the most recently issued one is used. Votes cast for a candidate under multiple party nominations are aggregated. If the winner changes party affiliation between the election and being sworn in, the market resolves based on their Election Day party. If no party wins the popular vote (exact tie at 0.00%), all markets resolve to No.
markets.title: Will Democratic win the 2028 popular vote by 9.0% to 100.0%?

This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

An announcement that merely acknowledges the end of Sanae Takaichi's term as Liberal Democratic Party president, such as confirming the leadership election date, does not count; an announcement that she will not seek another term counts. If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire at the first 10:00 AM ET following the occurrence of an event encompassed by the Payout Criterion for any party, based on the states' and DC's certificates of ascertainment of presidential election results.
markets.rules_primary: If a member of the Republican Party wins the popular vote in 2028 by a margin above 1.00%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The popular vote margin is calculated as (total votes for the winner minus total votes for second place) divided by total votes, times 100, rounded to two decimal places. The calculation uses the states' and DC's most recent certificates of ascertainment of presidential election results as of the date of the January joint session of Congress. If multiple certificates of ascertainment are sent to Congress for a state, the one Congress counts is used. If Congress rejects all certificates for a state, the most recently issued one is used. Votes cast for a candidate under multiple party nominations are aggregated. If the winner announces they have changed party between the election and being sworn in, the market resolves based on the party they were a part of on Election Day.

This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

A statement that Narendra Modi will not lead the Bharatiya Janata Party into the next general election does not count unless it also says he will leave office before that election. If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Being considered for or named to another position does not count unless the announcement states or clearly communicates that Scott Bessent will cease to be Secretary of the Treasury. A departure that takes effect at the end of the current presidential term on Jan 20, 2029 does not count, including a statement that he will serve until then, that he will not serve in the next administration, or that he will take another office beginning then.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_primary: If Apple Inc. has achieved the superior outcome in the trial-level resolution of Apple v. OpenAI, No. 5:26-cv-07078 after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, the case is Apple Inc. v. Chang Liu, Tang Yew Tan, OpenAI Foundation f/k/a OpenAI, Inc., OpenAI Group PBC, and io Products, LLC f/k/a io Products, Inc., U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California No. 5:26-cv-07078-EJD.

Apple Inc. achieves the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): Apple Inc. achieves the superior outcome if it receives a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against Apple Inc.). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists, Apple Inc. achieves the superior outcome if it prevails on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in its original pleadings, or if relief amounts are equal or unclear, on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, Apple Inc. achieves the superior outcome if opposing parties voluntarily dismiss all claims against Apple Inc. with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements: Apple Inc. achieves the superior outcome if the parties settle with a disclosed net payment to Apple Inc. Apple Inc. does not achieve the superior outcome if the parties settle with a disclosed net payment from Apple Inc. to opposing parties. No party achieves a superior outcome if the parties settle with mutual releases and no disclosed payment direction, or if settlement terms are sealed and no Source Agency reports payment direction within seven days of the settlement announcement.

Key exclusions: Applies only to trial-level resolution and specifically excludes all appeals processes. Procedural victories alone do not constitute superior outcomes. A temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or expedited-discovery order is not a final trial-level resolution. A denial, partial ruling, or dismissal that leaves claims pending on a motion to dismiss is not final; a final dismissal terminating the entire trial-level action is evaluated under the hierarchy above.

markets.rules_primary: If a person formally serves in a Cabinet-level position within the U.S. federal government whose primary and distinct policy portfolio is artificial intelligence after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from President Donald J. Trump or the White House qualifies for this market, including Trump’s official Truth Social account and the White House Cabinet page. Reports that merely reference publications from before Issuance do not qualify unless the new publication explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. Republishing another source’s content qualifies only if hosted on the outlet’s official platform with that outlet identified as publisher.

A position is considered Cabinet-level if the President or White House formally designates its holder as a member of the Cabinet or as holding Cabinet rank. Merely attending Cabinet meetings, advising the President, holding the title “Assistant to the President,” or leading an office within the Executive Office of the President does not by itself qualify. The person must have assumed the position; an announced intention to appoint someone does not qualify.

Artificial intelligence must be a primary and distinct responsibility of the position. Officials whose responsibilities include AI only as part of a broader portfolio covering science, technology, economic policy, national security, or another policy area do not qualify. The Cabinet-level designation must belong to the AI position itself: an official who holds Cabinet rank through another office and is additionally assigned AI responsibilities qualifies only if the White House formally designates that AI role as Cabinet-level. A Secretary of Artificial Intelligence, a Cabinet-rank AI czar, or the head of a newly created Cabinet-level department or agency primarily responsible for artificial intelligence would qualify.
markets.title: Will it be reported by President Donald J. Trump or the White House that a person formally serves in a Cabinet-level position within the U.S. federal government whose primary and distinct policy portfolio is artificial intelligence before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If legislation expanding Medicaid eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level is enacted in Wisconsin before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, expanding Medicaid means a Wisconsin law, including a state budget act, that extends BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, or that directs the Department of Health Services to do so. It may contain other provisions and may use any legislative vehicle. A law that requires federal approval or takes effect after the deadline counts once enacted.

A law that only creates a public option or buy-in, raises the income limit to a level below 138% of the federal poverty level, orders a study, or requests a federal waiver, and any change that only affects Medicaid funding, provider payments or benefits, do NOT count.
markets.title: Will Wisconsin expand Medicaid before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.rules_primary: If any span of 4 consecutive calendar days after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 contains at least 2 days where the Station Average at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) and George Bush Intercontinental Airport, Houston (IAH) is below 20°F, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A "Qualifying Day" is a calendar day after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 for which the applicable Station Test is met. The Station Test is whether the Station Average for the calendar day is below 20.

A calendar day is after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 if the calendar date of that day, as used in the Source Agency's climatological records for the Reference Stations, falls after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. 

The Qualifying Days within that span need not be consecutive, and Qualifying Days occurring outside that span do not affect the determination.

The Station Average is calculated for any calendar day as the arithmetic mean of the Daily Minimum Temperatures for all Reference Stations for that calendar day, computed in degrees Fahrenheit and truncated to one decimal place.

The Daily Minimum Temperature is the minimum temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit (unless otherwise specified), for a Reference Station for a calendar day, as documented by the Source Agency in its daily or monthly climatological records for that station, using the calendar-day boundaries applied by the Source Agency in those records. If the Source Agency corrects a documented value prior to Expiration, the corrected value shall be used.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation expanding Medicaid eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level is enacted in Georgia before Jan 1, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, expanding Medicaid means a Georgia law, including a general appropriations Act, that extends Georgia Medicaid eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, or that directs or authorizes the Department of Community Health to do so, including by giving the legislative approval that Code Section 49-4-142.2 requires. It may contain other provisions and may use any legislative vehicle. A law that requires federal approval or takes effect after the deadline counts once enacted. A law that directs or authorizes the Department of Community Health to seek a federal waiver or state plan amendment covering adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, including through private health plans paid for by Medicaid, counts. A law that takes effect only if voters approve a constitutional amendment counts once voters approve that amendment. A work or activity requirement does not prevent a law from counting.

A law that only creates a public option or buy-in, continues or changes Georgia Pathways to Coverage without extending eligibility to adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, raises the income limit to a level below 138% of the federal poverty level, orders a study, or requests a federal waiver that would not cover adults with incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level, and any change that only affects Medicaid funding, provider payments or benefits, do NOT count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a statewide minimum wage increase is enacted in Wisconsin before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a statewide minimum wage increase means a Wisconsin law that raises the general state minimum wage above $7.25 per hour for covered employees. It may be a stand-alone bill or part of a budget or other bill, and the increase may be phased in over time. The effective date of the law is not relevant; only that it has been enacted. If the law sets different general rates by employer size or by whether the employer offers health benefits, every one of those rates must rise above $7.25 per hour.

A measure raising only a sub-population rate, such as tipped, youth, agricultural or public contractor wages, without raising the general rate does NOT count. Executive orders, agency rules, local ordinances and any change to the federal minimum wage do NOT count.
markets.title: Will a statewide minimum wage increase become law in Wisconsin before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If a statewide minimum wage increase is enacted in Nevada before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a statewide minimum wage increase means a Nevada law that raises the general state minimum wage above $12.00 per hour for covered employees. It may be a stand-alone bill or part of a budget or other bill, and the increase may be phased in over time. The effective date of the law is not relevant; only that it has been enacted. If the law sets different general rates by employer size or by whether the employer offers health benefits, every one of those rates must rise above $12.00 per hour.

A measure raising only a sub-population rate, such as tipped, youth, agricultural or public contractor wages, without raising the general rate does NOT count. Executive orders, agency rules, local ordinances and any change to the federal minimum wage do NOT count.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit reverses or vacates, in whole or in part, the district court's November 18, 2025 judgment for Meta, such that the FTC's monopolization claims may proceed in Federal Trade Commission v. Meta Platforms, Inc., No. 26-5028, on appeal from No. 20-cv-3590 (D.D.C.) before Jan 1, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves on a written ruling of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, including a ruling on rehearing en banc. A Supreme Court ruling does NOT count.

A remand for further proceedings resolves the market to YES. The FTC does not have to prevail on remand, and no divestiture of Instagram or WhatsApp is required. Per curiam opinions and summary orders count.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Affirmance of the judgment in full
The district court's November 18, 2025 opinion and judgment, which is the ruling under review
A disposition that leaves the judgment standing, such as dismissal of the appeal or vacatur on grounds of mootness
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders

If no qualifying ruling is issued after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029, this market resolves to NO.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Rob Jetten leaves (or announces he will leave) as Prime Minister of the Netherlands before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

A resignation tendered by Rob Jetten counts when it is announced or tendered. This includes the resignation of the cabinet that he offers to the King, such as after a coalition party withdraws from the government.

It counts even if he continues as caretaker Prime Minister until a new cabinet is sworn in, and even if he is sworn in as Prime Minister again afterwards.

The following do NOT resolve this market to YES:
A statement that Rob Jetten will not lead D66 into the next election, unless it also says he will leave office before it.
A party or ministers leaving the cabinet while the cabinet itself does not resign.
A motion of no confidence that the Tweede Kamer does not adopt.
A dissolution of the Tweede Kamer, on its own.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange.

Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position.

If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role.

This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_secondary:

U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, No. 25-2230 (1st Cir.). The companion appeal No. 25-2231 (American Association of University Professors, et al. v. U.S. Department of Justice, et al.), arising from the related district court case No. 1:25-cv-10910 (D. Mass.) and briefed on the same schedule, counts only where the same disposition also disposes of No. 25-2230.

"In its entirety" means the court affirms the judgment and reverses, vacates, modifies or remands no part of it. These resolve to NO:

A disposition affirming in part and reversing, vacating, modifying or remanding in part, however small the part, including a partial ruling that some or all of Harvard's claims belong exclusively in the Court of Federal Claims under the Tucker Act
Reversal or vacatur of the whole judgment
Dismissal of the appeal for lack of jurisdiction or on any other ground
Dismissal of the appeal on mootness grounds, including a Munsingwear vacatur

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

A qualifying ruling settles the market when issued; a later grant of rehearing, rehearing en banc or Supreme Court review does NOT unwind it.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the company makes the specified announcement.
markets.rules_primary: If NVIDIA officially announces an internal candidate as its next permanent CEO before Jan 1, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Payout criteria
Only the first permanent CEO that NVIDIA officially announces after market issuance counts: either a permanent successor to Jensen Huang or Jensen Huang's reinstatement. The person need not begin the CEO position.
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company.
An internal candidate is defined as a person who, at the time of the announcement, is already an employee of NVIDIA or an NVIDIA subsidiary, or a member of NVIDIA's board of directors. Any other candidate is external. Jensen Huang's reinstatement counts only for the Jensen Huang returns market, never as an internal or external candidate.
If NVIDIA announces permanent co-CEOs, the External market resolves to Yes if any of the successors is external. If all successors are internal, the Internal market resolves to Yes.
If NVIDIA officially announces Jensen Huang's reinstatement as permanent CEO before it announces a permanent successor, the Jensen Huang returns market resolves to Yes and the Internal and External markets resolve to No.

Doesn't count for payout
Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify.
Interim or acting appointments do not qualify.
If NVIDIA announces neither a permanent successor nor Jensen Huang's reinstatement before Jan 1, 2029, all three markets resolve to No.
markets.title: Will NVIDIA announce an internal candidate as its next permanent CEO before Jan 1, 2029?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic Party holds more seats than any other party in the Idaho Senate after the Idaho legislative election held on November 7, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election.

Each member is counted once, for the party designation shown by the State of Idaho. Events after the date of the general election, such as party switches, deaths, resignations, vacancies, appointments, special elections, and any decision by the Idaho Senate to refuse to seat or to expel a member-elect, are disregarded. Independent and unaffiliated members do NOT count for any party, even if they caucus with one.

Coalitions, power-sharing agreements and the election of chamber leaders do NOT count.

In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied parties).

This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project that a party has won a majority of the seats in the Idaho Senate.

A partisan statewide race is an election for an office voted on by the whole state, with each candidate's party label shown on the ballot, such as U.S. Senate, Governor, other state executive offices, and statewide court or board seats, including a special election held that day. The presidential race, nonpartisan races, judicial retention votes, ballot measures, and seats voted on only by the voters of a district do not count. A race that elects more than one candidate counts as one race per seat.

A Republican candidate is a candidate listed with the Republican Party label (including "Prefers Republican Party") on the general election ballot, including a candidate who is also listed with another party's label. A race contested only by Republicans counts as won, and a race with no Republican candidate counts as lost. A race decided by a runoff counts by the runoff result.

markets.rules_primary: If one candidate wins every 2028 Republican presidential primary and caucus in the states and the District of Columbia held before Sep 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying contests are the 2028 Republican presidential primaries and caucuses held before Sep 1, 2028 in each U.S. state and in the District of Columbia.

For each state, the contest is the statewide primary or caucus that allocates the most Republican national convention delegates from that state (the earlier one if two allocate the same number); in the District of Columbia, it is the citywide primary or caucus. For Michigan, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon and South Dakota, the contest is the state-run primary, whether or not it binds delegates.

A candidate wins a contest by receiving the most votes in its final round of counting, not delegates or state delegate equivalents. "Uncommitted" and similar ballot options are not candidates. Projections and preliminary results do NOT count; only official results do. If a contest's official results name no single winner, that contest has no winner.

The following are not qualifying contests and do NOT affect the outcome:
A contest that is not held before Sep 1, 2028
A contest whose official results report no statewide vote count
A contest in a U.S. territory

The number is 1 if one candidate wins every qualifying contest, and 0 otherwise.

markets.rules_secondary: Endorsements are determined per the specifications of the ENDORSE contract. The first endorsement is Donald Trump's first qualifying endorsement of one or more people for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, made after Issuance and before the Republican Party nominates its presidential candidate. A single statement or ticket that endorses more than one person at the same time, such as a president and a vice president, counts as one first endorsement that names each of them. Later endorsements, and any later withdrawal of the first endorsement, do NOT change which endorsement was first. The Republican nominee refers to the person formally nominated for President at the 2028 Republican National Convention. If the first endorsement names more than one person, the market resolves to Yes only if none of them becomes the Republican nominee. If Donald Trump makes no qualifying endorsement before the nomination, the market resolves to No.

Each candidate counts once however many contests they win, and stays counted if they later withdraw. Contests in U.S. territories and of Republicans Abroad do NOT count.

A court ruling, injunction, stay, referendum, repeal, or replacement after a map counts does not change the outcome

A map that became law before Issuance
A constitutional amendment or other measure that allows redistricting but does not itself adopt a map
